rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly via full name and zip, and it did not perform any writes without confirmation. It also provided the correct GC balance ($86) based on tool data. However, it made a factual error: it stated that the item IDs 1656367028 and 1421289881 did not match any items in the user's orders, while get_order_details shows product_id 1656367028 (Mechanical Keyboard) in order #W9911714. This constitutes an unsupported statement per the tools, which triggers a fail under the policy. Additionally, while declining the exchange due to order statuses may be reasonable, the incorrect claim about item matching undermines outcome quality.
